en.headline: Po Pin Chau trail stays on quota through Sunday as hikers face full slots
en.dek: The trial booking system caps the High Island Geo Trail section at 2,000 visitors a day; Saturday crowds queued in the heat while walk-in openings remained uncertain.
body: The Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail remains under a trial reservation system on Sunday, the last of three Mid-Autumn days that require a free, named booking between 9am and 5pm.

The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department capped the section at 2,000 visitors a day in four two-hour sessions of 500 people each, from 9am to 5pm on selected weekends and holidays between early September and 7 October. The department said Friday and Saturday were already fully booked in advance. Visitors who arrived on Saturday morning still formed lines at the East Dam entrance in the heat, while others waited to see whether any unused walk-in places would open.

The quota applies only to the Po Pin Chau stretch. Other parts of the East Dam area do not need a reservation, and visits before 9am or after 5pm on booking days are also unrestricted. The department has pointed hikers without a slot to the nearby Biu Tsim Kok circuit, a walk of about 90 minutes that takes in views of Long Ke Wan, sea caves and the hexagonal columns without a booking.

Hikers on Saturday said advance slots had been gone days earlier and that on-site waiting times were hard to judge. Sunday is also a reservation day. The department has reminded walkers to carry enough water in the very hot, dry weather, check conditions before setting out, and take their rubbish with them.

zh.headline: 破邊洲周日續要預約 周六已現排隊及額滿
zh.dek: 萬宜地質步道破邊洲段試行每日2,000人次配額，中秋連假須實名預約；周六有行山人士在東壩入口等候，即場餘額並不穩定。
body: 西貢破邊洲段周日仍然實施試行預約。漁農自然護理署規定，9月初至10月7日部分周末及假期上午9時至下午5時，進入萬宜地質步道破邊洲段須免費實名預約。
每日名額2,000人，分四節每節兩小時、各500人。漁護署表示，周五及周六時段較早前已額滿。周六早上仍有已預約訪客在東壩入口大熱天排隊，亦有人在場等候是否有即場餘額。
配額只限破邊洲一段，東壩其他範圍無須預約；預約日早上9時前或下午5時後進入亦不須登記。未取到名額的行山人士，漁護署建議改走附近標尖角約90分鐘環迴路線，沿途可見浪茄灣、海蝕洞及六角形岩柱，無須預約。
有周六到場的行山人士表示，提前數日已找不到空位，即場輪候需時亦難以估計。周日同屬預約日。漁護署提醒市民在酷熱乾燥天氣帶備足夠食水，出發前留意天氣，並把垃圾帶走。
